clue.text: Run and puff-nurse needed!

parts.note: a puff is a promotional plug, an advertisement, shortened to ad
to minister is to tend or nurse someone

explanation.surface: An urgent call for a nurse to come and give a dose of something.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen in 'puff-nurse' is surface glue only; the two words give separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To run a business or country is to manage or govern it, as an official does.

clue.text: Crawlers making a simpleton accept very little money

indicators.note: to accept something is to take it in, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: an ass is a foolish person
P, a penny, is the smallest British coin

explanation.surface: Creepy things inducing a fool to take a pittance.
explanation.definitionFit: Snakes are creatures that crawl along the ground, and these are a venomous kind.

clue.text: A single flower in old pottery can be quite overwhelming

indicators.note: the flower is placed in the pottery, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: Ming is porcelain of the Chinese Ming dynasty
an aster is a daisy-like garden flower

explanation.surface: A lone bloom in an antique vase makes an overpowering display.
explanation.definitionFit: Mastering an opponent is overcoming or subduing them completely.

clue.text: For this woman it's usual to lose a pound

indicators.note: losing something means it is taken away from the word it was in

parts.note: normal means usual or ordinary
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Losing money is a regular occurrence for a certain woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Norma is a woman's given name, so it fits a reference to a particular woman.

clue.text: Dinner one perhaps takes on the tennis court?

definitions.meaning: a dinner set of plates and dishes is an example of a set of tableware
what a player takes in turn to start each point in tennis

explanation.definitionFit: A dinner set is a matching collection of tableware, and in tennis the delivery that starts a point is the serve.

clue.text: Out of jam, say

parts.note: ex is a Latin prefix meaning out of or from
a press is a crush or jam of people

explanation.surface: Someone who has run out of preserves, as they might put it.
explanation.definitionFit: To express a thought is to state or voice it.

clue.text: Hot music grows on one

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap
an air is a tune or melody

explanation.surface: Lively music gradually becomes more appealing to a listener.
explanation.definitionFit: The strands on a person's head and body are what grow on them.

clue.text: Aware creative work will absorb the French

indicators.note: absorbing something means taking it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: art is creative work such as painting
le is the French masculine word for the

explanation.surface: Someone conscious that artwork will take in French influence.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone alert is watchful and fully conscious of what is going on.

clue.text: Keeping outside right for further instruction

indicators.note: one piece is outside the other, enclosing it

parts.note: retaining means keeping or holding on to

explanation.surface: Holding a winger out wide while coaching them further.
explanation.definitionFit: Being taught again or given more teaching is a fresh course of education.

clue.text: Being charitable, one urges reform

indicators.note: to reform is to reshape, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A benevolent person calling for social change.
explanation.definitionFit: A charitable person is open-handed and gives freely to others.

clue.text: The sitter's dilemma

definitions.meaning: a person sitting for a portrait or photograph
a puzzling problem that is hard to solve

explanation.definitionFit: A model holding a pose for an artist and a perplexing question both share the same word.

clue.text: Serving men now act for…

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of British soldiers
the present is now, the current time

explanation.surface: Soldiers on duty now take the part of others, continuing into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this clue to the next in the surface only.
explanation.definitionFit: To act for someone is to stand in for them as their agent or delegate.

clue.text: … member of the family that is arranging travel movement

indicators.note: arranging puts these letters into a fresh order

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A family member organising a trip, continuing from the previous clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'movement' only completes the surface, picking up 'travel'.
explanation.definitionFit: A kinsman or kinswoman is a person connected to you by blood or marriage.

clue.text: In this context rather more is wanted

indicators.note: in says the letters are found inside the following words

explanation.surface: A comment that, in a given setting, a little more would be welcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Something additional is a bit more than the usual amount.

clue.text: A trying individual

parts.note: not a tiresome person but one whose job is to try cases in court

explanation.definitionFit: A justice of the peace or lower-court judge hears and tries cases.

clue.text: It is, in a way, in trouble

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other

parts.note: a gate is a way through or way in
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something stuck on the road causing difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: To trouble someone is to disturb or upset them, making them anxious.

clue.text: Any deals could be investigated

indicators.note: could be suggests the letters may become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: All business transactions might face scrutiny.
explanation.definitionFit: To have examined something methodically in detail is to have investigated it.

clue.text: Taking issue about breaking down a mountain

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: issue means offspring, such as a son

indicators.note: breaking shatters the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' turns DOWN into NOWD, which goes inside SON. SNOWDON is the highest mountain in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest peak in Wales is a well-known mountain in the British Isles.

clue.text: Application for a coach

explanation.definitionFit: Careful persistent effort and an old public stagecoach share this name.

clue.text: The person showing no appreciation of trendy file

parts.note: in means fashionable or trendy
to grate is to rasp or file down

explanation.surface: Someone ungrateful for a fashionable nail file.
explanation.definitionFit: An ungrateful person shows no thanks for what others do for them.

clue.text: A man withdrawn before receiving discharge

indicators.note: receiving means taking something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
to emit is to give out or discharge

explanation.surface: A retiring man had been discharged earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit or recluse is a person who has retreated from society, often for religious reasons.

clue.text: One slip made for a Greek character

indicators.note: made suggests the letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A single mistake from a Greek actor.
explanation.definitionFit: The fifth letter of the Greek alphabet is one of its characters.

clue.text: Eric's occupied by a renegade vagrant

indicators.note: being occupied by something means it sits inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: the name is taken as written
a rat is a traitor or deserter

explanation.surface: A man named Eric is taken over by a turncoat wanderer.
explanation.definitionFit: Vagrant can mean wandering or unpredictable, which is what erratic describes.

clue.text: Play about divine drink

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: to toy is to play idly
DD stands for Doctor of Divinity, a clergyman or divine

explanation.surface: A drama involving a heavenly drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot alcoholic mixture of spirits, water and sugar is a traditional drink.

clue.text: Theatrical make-up

parts.note: not greasepaint on an actor's face but the way a stage is made up with scenery

explanation.definitionFit: The scenery and furnishings of a stage set make up its appearance.

clue.text: They may well depend on a woman

definitions.text: They may well depend on a woman

parts.words: They may well depend on a woman
parts.note: depend is used in its literal sense of hang down, as jewellery from a woman's ears

explanation.definitionFit: Jewellery worn on the lobes hangs from a woman's ears.

clue.text: Norwegian writer found in the same place with Japanese money

parts.note: ib is short for ibidem, Latin for in the same place
the sen is a small Japanese coin

explanation.surface: A Scandinavian author turning up alongside yen.
explanation.definitionFit: Henrik Ibsen was the Norwegian dramatist who wrote A Doll's House.

clue.text: Others break

explanation.definitionFit: The remainder of a group and a pause for relaxation share this word.

clue.text: New claims the old scientist's made

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are freshly ordered

explanation.surface: Fresh claims are made by an old scientist.
explanation.definitionFit: A medieval practitioner who tried to turn base metals into gold was an early scientist.

clue.text: Reason a nurse takes direction

parts.note: SEN was a State Enrolled Nurse in Britain
SE is south-east, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A carer shows reason in taking a lead.
explanation.definitionFit: Good judgment or rationality, as in talking sense, is reason.

clue.text: Listening equipment left for the man entitled

parts.note: the ear is the organ for hearing

explanation.surface: A hearing device left for a titled gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: A British nobleman ranking above a viscount holds a title.

clue.text: Depression after many created scene coming down

indicators.note: after says the first-mentioned piece comes behind the others

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number

indicators.note: created suggests the letters are formed into something new

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression

explanation.surface: A gloomy mood following a big scene of collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'created' turns SCENE into ESCEN, placed between D and DENT.
